lines.1: 「I really don't feel like going to the student council.」
lines.3: 「Use a word that stirs your maternal instinct. Call me sensitive.」
lines.4: 「I made Yashi mad yesterday. Of course I'd feel awkward seeing her.」
lines.9: 「Why don't you all go die once?」
lines.10: 「A-All right, I've decided. The crustacean has a point.」
lines.11: 「I won't be scared of someone younger than me.」
lines.18: 「Yashi has departed for the Dragon Palace--the student council room.」
lines.20: 「Heh. So that's all? She had me worried.」
lines.21: 「...Pathetic. How'd I end up childhood friends with this guy?」
lines.27: 「Once I thought it over calmly, I figured I might as well give it a try.」
lines.30: 「That helps a lot. The Princess convinced you properly, just as expected.」
lines.31: 「Yashi, I look forward to working with you.」
lines.33: 「Tomorrow is the big day, so today and tomorrow morning are the real crunch. It will be hard work, but thank you.」
lines.36: Yashi had a strong sense of responsibility, so she would be fine.
lines.37: Still, what on earth had changed her mind?
lines.38: But if I asked carelessly and set her off again, I'd regret it.
lines.42: 「...So Nagomin is off the team, but we have other helpers. We'll manage. Tomorrow is the real thing, so let's give it our all.」
lines.43: 「Today we put the finishing touches on the field.」
lines.44: 「Then get out there and work up a sweat.」
lines.50: We changed into our gym clothes and assembled.
lines.53: 「Put some spirit into it! Television crews will be here too!」
lines.55: 「This isn't really my scene... I'll go help with the decorations.」
lines.57: 「Tsushima, what are you doing? If you're on the student council executive committee, hurry up and help us.」
lines.61: 「Move your hands before you move your mouths.」
lines.62: Otome charged off, dragging the field rake behind her.
lines.63: In no time at all, she was a speck in the distance.
lines.69: 「Doesn't it feel good to accomplish something together with everyone?」
lines.70: 「I guess... Though I feel like I spent most of the day fighting with class 2-A.」
lines.71: Still, the sense of accomplishment was pretty satisfying.
lines.72: 「...The Sports and Martial Arts Festival is a points competition between the North, South, East, and West Armies.」
lines.73: 「I am in 3-A, so I belong to the East Army with 2-A. You are in 2-C, so you belong to the West Army with 3-C and 1-B. In other words, we are enemies.」
lines.74: 「If we meet in an event, I will show no mercy.」
lines.76: So Otome and I were enemies...
lines.77: It was reassuring to have the Princess and Subaru on my side, though.
lines.78: Wait, if 1-B was West too, then Yashi was on our side.
lines.79: Yohei Murata and Nishizaki from 2-A were definitely the enemy.
lines.80: This was shaping up to be one heated battle.
lines.81: 「I made special rice balls to build up your stamina today.」
lines.83: 「Um, when an entire slab of meat is sitting on top, hasn't it stopped being a rice ball?」
lines.84: 「The mayonnaise between the Spam and rice is the secret ingredient.」
lines.87: She forced the rice ball into my mouth.
lines.88: C-Could the East Army's attack have already begun?
lines.89: Even so, the rice ball was delicious.
